header.name: Creativity, Innovation, and Inventive Problem Solving
header.description: The goal of this workshop style course is to trigger creative thinking in students and equip them with tools to not only brainstorm, but also to utilize existing knowledge to arrive at inventive solutions to problems. The course establishes basics of creative thinking and throws light on pyschological interia and various blocks to creative thinking. It then introduces formal brainstorming methods. The course then introduces methods for systematic problem solving through modeling of existing system; remodeling for increasing value; and structured solution search and ideation. As a part of the entrepreneurship minor, the course will encourage students to present and sell their inventions in a mock pitch-cafe.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Identify a range of creativity enhancement and brainstorming tools and determine the tool most suited for the problem setting.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Distinguish between different stages of Creativity and Innovation Cycles

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Generate ideas in free brainstorm sessions and organize them in structured manner by using tools like mind-maps

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Construct functional models of engineering systems and modify them to create new problem statements

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Generate ideas using structured brainstorm methods and utilize available knowledge databases to refine solutions.

lecture_topics: Function Oriented Search: Patent Search, Supplier Search, Market Search
